main_text.head: SUBSECTIO SECUNDA De Subactione Monarchiæ regno Christi adversariæ
Analysis.
main_text.p: §. 1.ONtinuatur hinc porrò fermo Dei, atque pergit à judicio Judæorum (qui se subduxerant) ad judicium gentium, sub insigni monarchatu se præconio regni Christi opponentium; quæ duo judicia hic loci ita inter se comparantur, ut etiam tanquam proximè cohærentia connectantur: quam comparationem excutiemus ad verf. 5. Hinc facilè colligimus subsequentium rerum argumentum non posse referri ad tempora præconium testis istius veracis fidemque adstipulantium antecedentia: sed necessario spectare ad tempus regni Christi, à quo ecclesia credentium in Christum fuit collecta. Aberrant enim à sermonis tenore isti Interpretes, qui nescio quo saltu retrogradò hic ad tempora monarchiæ Babylonicæ resiliunt: comparatur enim Monarcha aliquis perfidus, in visione oblatus, respectu judicii perferendi, cum Judæis, ob subductionem supplicio affectis: unde sequitur prioris judicium post illud Judæorum fuisse exspectandum. Apponimus hic, quæ Cl. Coccejus habet in commentario suo. „ Hanc descriptionem judicandi (inquit) multi interpretes accommodant Babylonio. page.notes: The first word is a large decorated initial "C" followed by "ONtinuatur"; the printed word is "Continuatur", the initial C is shown as a woodcut and joined to the word, so it is written here as "Continuatur" with the first letter restored. The "Aaa 2" line is a gathering signature and is shown in the foot element. The left-margin bullet and the text "quare" at the foot are catchword and printed marks. Several italic and quoted words are in the printed original; the opening quotation mark before "Hanc" is printed. Some characters at the right edge of the scan are faint and were read with confidence only where legible.
